judged_text: The migration joins site_settings.value to categories.name, but the removed embed_category setting stored a category ID string, not a category name, so the join can never match. For every existing production install the category lookup returns empty, category_id resolves to 0 and falls back to the uncategorized category, silently reassigning all embedded-topic routing that previously used embed_category; the advertised data migration never migrates the category.
